subject: Sequence migration pilot + purchase roadmap (HubSpot <> Outreach connector)
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Raman <priya@blueridge.consulting>
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sequence migration pilot + purchase roadmap (HubSpot <> Outreach connector)

Team —

Quick background: Outreach has proposed a pilot to validate a HubSpot<>Outreach bi-directional sequence connector and a managed migration for ~300 seats. BlueRidge (cc'd) would run the migration and alignment work for our sequence templates and reporting.

Ask: I need a short checklist from procurement and sales ops so we can (1) accept the Outreach pilot quote, (2) get a signed SOW for BlueRidge, and (3) align billing cadence so we don't double-pay during the Feb renewal window.

Constraints: Legal wants a 60‑day review window on any SOW. Finance prefers milestone billing for the migration piece. Our renewal for HubSpot seats is 2028-02-01 — ideally the pilot runs Jan and we flip billing at the HubSpot renewal.

Priority items I want by EOD Monday:
- Confirmation of procurement path (PO vs. contract charge)
- Required vendor evidence (SOC2 / security questionnaire)
- Target discount bands for pilot-to-prod conversion

I'll attach the Outreach quote once it arrives.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, GTM Systems
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@outreach.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@outreach.io, Priya Raman <priya@blueridge.consulting>
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sequence migration pilot + purchase roadmap (HubSpot <> Outreach connector)

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the note. Attached is the Outreach pilot quote (Outreach-quote-20271203.pdf). Short summary: 3-month pilot for 300 seats (pilot pricing applied for month 1 and 2), managed connector support and priority onboarding. If you convert to an annual contract after the pilot we can apply a 10% conversion credit toward the first year.

We can provide our SOC2 Type II report and a completed security questionnaire; I’ve attached Outreach-SOC2-2026.pdf. For contracting we accept standard PO or a simple MSA + SOW.

For the connector piece BlueRidge can be the implementation partner; we’ll coordinate SOW acceptance and a single billing path if you prefer (we can invoice BlueRidge for the Outreach piece and they invoice you, or Outreach invoices Redwood directly).

Attachment: Outreach-quote-20271203.pdf (pricing summary)
Attachment: Outreach-SOC2-2026.pdf

Let me know which procurement flow you prefer and we’ll route paperwork. Happy to hop on a 20-min call early next week to close timing.

Best,
Alex Turner
Enterprise Sales, Outreach
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Raman <priya@blueridge.consulting>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@outreach.io>
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 14:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sequence migration pilot + purchase roadmap (HubSpot <> Outreach connector)

Thanks Alex / Hannah. Quick ops notes:
- Preferred flow: Outreach invoices Redwood directly for the pilot (so we can apply any conversion credits cleanly).
- For the migration services BlueRidge should provide an SOW we can attach to the PO; I asked Priya to share the initial SOW draft (BlueRidge-SOW-SeqMigration-v1.docx).
- Finance preference: milestone billing (25% upfront, 50% on template migration completion, 25% on final acceptance). Can Outreach accept milestone invoicing for the migration line item?

Karthik / Finance — can you confirm if we can route Outreach pilot under standard procurement (PO + 30 days) and issue a separate PO for BlueRidge professional services with milestone terms? Also, any constraints on applying a conversion credit if we sign an annual Outreach contract after pilot completion?

Marissa
Sr. Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, procurement@outreach.io, Priya Raman <priya@blueridge.consulting>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2027 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sequence migration pilot + purchase roadmap (HubSpot <> Outreach connector)

Marissa / team —

Procurement confirmation and next steps:
1) Outreach pilot (product seats): Outreach can be procured with a PO under our standard terms (Net 30). We will need the final quote PDF and an invoice remit address.
2) BlueRidge SOW (services): BlueRidge should return a signed SOW. Procurement will open a separate PO for consulting services with milestone invoicing; please ensure the SOW lists the milestone deliverables and acceptance criteria.
3) Security/compliance: Outreach SOC2 doc received — good. Priya, please confirm BlueRidge's security posture and whether they have an SSAE/SOC report or similar.
4) Discounts / conversion credits: We can request the 10% conversion credit be documented in the quote and the MSA so Finance can apply accounting treatment. If Outreach wants to invoice BlueRidge and have BlueRidge bill us, we need a subcontractor flow documented; preferred is Outreach invoicing Redwood directly to simplify accounting.

Timeline: Procurement can turn a PO around in ~5 business days once we have signed quote + SOW + vendor W-9. Legal will need 3 business days to review SOW language (60-day review not required for < $100k services but we’ll route per policy). Target: pilot start 2028-01-08; please confirm by COB Wed so we can issue POs.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Head of Procurement & Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@outreach.io>, Priya Raman <priya@blueridge.consulting>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sequence migration pilot + purchase roadmap (HubSpot <> Outreach connector)

Confirmed — proceed with Outreach direct invoice and separate PO for BlueRidge services per Karthik's note.
Next steps for ops: Marissa to confirm final headcount (we currently assume 300 seats) and Priya to send final SOW with milestone definitions. Alex — please add the 10% conversion credit language to the quote and MSA draft, and provide the invoice remit details.

If we get all items in place by Wednesday COB we can hit the Jan 8 pilot kick-off. Green to move forward on my side.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
VP, Revenue Operations
